decision_rules.text: An authority agent issued BLOCK backed by at least one verified, relevant quote (8+ words) from a binding UAE federal or emirate law or school policy (not guidance).

Precautionary suspension: an authority agent rated the risk HIGH and backed its assessment with a verified, relevant quote (8+ words) from a binding UAE law or school policy, even though its verdict was NEED_INFO or CONDITIONS. Lifted like R1 (see R5).
An authority agent needs information, an agent or retrieval failed, or a verdict was unsupported by evidence.
At least one authority agent approved with conditions (all conditions are merged).
All responding authority agents approved with verified, relevant evidence.
No authority agent responded in this stage; previous status is kept.
A suspension stays in force until every authority that issued it responds again with an evidence-backed APPROVE or CONDITIONS.
